name: InterContinental Hotel Festival City
positioning: InterContinental Dubai Festival City: a hotel on Dubai Creek with Creek-view rooms, a glass-bottom infinity pool and access to Dubai Festival City Mall
best_for: Travelers who want a Dubai Creek base close to Dubai International Airport
Families who want a kids' club and a mall on the doorstep
Guests who want a pool with skyline views

facts.text: The hotel sits on Dubai Creek.
The hotel offers access to Dubai Festival City Mall.
Dubai Festival City Mall is home to the IMAGINE water, laser and fire show.
The hotel is about 4 kilometers from Dubai International Airport.
The hotel is about 7.7 kilometers from the Burj Khalifa.
Rooms feature marble floors and vibrant jewel tones.
Rooms include touches such as a standalone bathtub and premium bedding.
The infinity pool has temperature-controlled water for year-round swimming.
A poolside bar serves drinks and snacks, with panoramic views of the Dubai skyline from the pool.
Pierre's TT serves authentic French cuisine and mixology with a waterfront ambience.
Eclipse is a cocktail bar on the 26th floor, tucked away behind a bookcase.
Complimentary valet and self-service parking is available.

highlights.text: A glass-bottom infinity pool is suspended above the hotel's fourth floor.
The hotel offers panoramic Dubai Creek views.
SPA InterContinental offers bespoke treatments, a selection of pools and a 24-hour fitness centre.
The Club Lounge on the 26th floor offers panoramic city views and personalised check-in.
Planet Trekkers kids' club offers activities such as rock climbing, arts and crafts and cooking classes.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel is located away from Dubai's main beach areas.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury InterContinental properties.
